title: Floe attrition chain: Wadell roundness -> Archard corner wear -> mu_eff(R) -> multi-pass ice resistance decay
note: Predictions below were fixed from the analytic structure of the model (see derivations in the 'derivation' fields) BEFORE the production verification run that produced artifacts/floe_attrition/criteria.json. The only quantity left free is the exponent beta of the roundness-decay fit; it is reported, not used as a criterion.

model.shape_family_2d: regular n-gon with corner fillets of radius r (single wear state variable)
model.wear_law: Archard: dV = k * W * ds / H, W = p * A_patch(r) (pressure controlled)
model.effective_friction: mu_eff(R,C) = mu_sph(C) + kappa_i * I(R) * Z(C)/Z_ref, kappa_i = 1, Z_ref = 4
model.resistance: R(N) = R_crush + mu_eff(R(N),C) * F_n(b_N) + sigma_c * b_N * A_b

design_of_experiment.replicate_disorder: regular-polygon side count n in {3,4,5,6} restricted to the side counts whose sharp roundness is below the level; fillet radius solved to hit the target roundness

predictions.statement: the closed-form Wadell roundness / sphericity equals an independent exact computation for analytic polygons and polyhedra
predictions.derivation: 2D: 4*pi*A/P^2 with A(r), P(r) exact for the filleted polygon, cross-checked by an exact Green's-theorem boundary integral (facet shoelace term + closed arc term). 3D: pi^(1/3)(6V)^(2/3)/A with exact Platonic (V,A) vs the ConvexHull descriptor; Steiner identity dV/dr = A at fixed inner cube.

predictions.statement: the geometry-inverted attrition reproduces the Archard-type closed form of the same law
predictions.threshold: relative error <= 10 % at the production cadence
predictions.derivation: V(r) = c2 r^2 and A_patch = chi r give r(s) = r0 + Omega s with Omega = k p chi / (2 c2 H); the only error is the explicit-patch discretisation, O(dr/r) per step.

predictions.statement: R(s) is a saturating decay that a two-parameter fit 1 - R = (1 - R0) exp(-(s/tau)^beta) reproduces
predictions.threshold: R^2 >= 0.99 in every pressure case, fit window = up to 63.2 % (1/e) of the residual
predictions.derivation: R(r) is smooth and monotone on [R0, 1]; the fit window is normalised by the same 1/e definition that defines tau.

predictions.statement: the relaxation sliding distance tau scales with the corner contact pressure as a power law with exponent -1
predictions.derivation: every term of the attrition rate is linear in p (load W = p A_patch), so d r / d s is proportional to p and the sliding needed to reach a given roundness scales as 1/p exactly, independent of k, H and the shape family.

predictions.statement: mu_eff tends to the m9375 disk-shear-cell baseline as R -> 1
predictions.threshold: bit-identical at R = 1 and <= 1 % for a near-circle polygon and for the chain run to full rounding
predictions.derivation: I(R) = R_c/R_ins - 1 is exactly 0 for a circle, so the interlocking term vanishes identically and mu_eff returns mu_sph(C).

predictions.statement: 3x3 design matrix: roundness and concentration main effects plus their interaction are reported from a balanced ANOVA; the interaction is an output, not an assumption
predictions.threshold: balanced design, 8 replicates per cell, ANOVA table with SS/df/MS/F/p and eta^2; if p(interaction) < 0.05 the mechanisms must be reported separately
predictions.derivation: the interlocking term is multiplicative in shape and contact density, so a non-zero interaction is expected; the criterion prevents narrating the two mechanisms as one blended effect.

predictions.statement: the multi-pass resistance change decomposes into a rounding and a consolidation share that close to 100 %
predictions.derivation: the two terms are the two halves of the total difference of R(N) = R_crush + mu*F_n(b) + sigma_c b A_b.

predictions.statement: the Archard ledger equals the geometric material loss and zero sliding is an exact fixed point
predictions.threshold: relative conservation error <= 1e-6; zero-slip wear volume identically 0
predictions.derivation: the state update inverts worn_volume(r) exactly at every step, so the ledger closes to brentq tolerance; k*W*0 = 0 exactly.

falsification_protocol: A criterion that fails is reported as an honest FAIL with its measured number; no threshold is relaxed after the run. Parameters that cannot be identified from the data (principally kappa_i and the pair k/H) are flagged as limitations and a sensitivity sweep is reported instead of a tuned value.
known_limitations_declared_up_front: kappa_i = 1 is a geometric O(1) coefficient, NOT calibrated against a DEM shear cell of rounded polygons at intermediate roundness (roadmap).
the DEM sphere baseline mu_sph(C) comes from a reduced shear window (1500 shear steps) of the m9375 shear cell; a full-length rerun is the refinement.
mu_eff is a stress ratio of a 2D disk field; the 3D rounded-cube family is verified geometrically but its friction closure inherits the 2D baseline.
the consolidation model (b(t) = 1 - exp(-t/t_c) with a load amplification beta_c) is a declared phenomenological stand-in, not a freeze-bond DEM.
